Irene (Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: a prospect asked whether Redwood can provide a signed, downloadable evidence bundle that proves audit-log integrity and key rotations for a 3rd-party audit. Any short guidance we can share now?

Mark (Security): Yes — we can generate an evidence bundle containing batch chain-hashes, signed rotation events, and exportable audit records. By default Redwood signs bundles. For Private/BYOK deployments we can call the customer's KMS/HSM and include their signature reference (we do NOT store key material).

Sofia (Product): Product note: Console -> Security -> Audit -> "Create evidence bundle" will be in beta next quarter. Bundles can be exported to customer S3 or a temporary download link. We'll include options to redact PII before export.

Ada (Privacy): Important: if bundles include PII or user-identifiable events, customers must declare lawful basis and we need DSAR handling documented. We'll add a short guide for redaction workflow and requester verification.

Irene (Eng): For BYOK, how do we prove Redwood never had the key material? Customers asked about an auditor-friendly statement.

Mark (Security): We provide an integration log that shows KMS/HSM endpoint calls, grant IDs, and that only key references were used. We also include signed assertions referencing the customer's key ARN/ID. For on-prem HSM we use mTLS and record the proxy's cert thumbprint in the bundle.

Sofia (Product): CLI example to generate a bundle (preview):
```\nredwoodctl audit bundle create --deployment dp-42 --start 2024-06-01 --end 2024-12-31 --include-rotations --destination s3://acct-evidence\n```
We'll publish full flags and RBAC notes.

Ada (Privacy): Action: I'll draft DSAR/redaction guidance for bundles. Mark: please add the BYOK integration proof template to the docs. Sofia: add UI timeline to roadmap page.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #TICKET-6001 "evidence-bundle-docs" assigned to Mark (Security) due 2025-03-15.

Mark (Security): Thanks 44d I'll post a short FAQ and the sample integration diagram in #eng-security later today. Ping me if you want to review the bundle spec.
